report.summary: Chunk 2 of 4: helper functions for read-only DB access, spec resolution, WorkerReport dataclass, and ProjectionWorker __init__.
risks: _ro_connect | medium | Returns None for :memory: path, but caller may expect a connection; comment says 'because there is no public API' but that is uncheckable. | Check if any caller passes :memory: and handles None correctly.
_stored_specs | low | Catches ValueError on corrupted metadata row but continues; this may hide data issues. | Confirm that skipping corrupt rows is intentional.

_stored_watermark | low | Returns None on error (catching sqlite3.Error) or missing row; but the docstring doesn't specify error handling. | Check if callers distinguish between 'no watermark' and 'error'.

resolve_spec | medium | When dimension is None and siblings >1, raises SpecConflictError; this may be unexpected for users who expect automatic resolution. | Verify that the error message guides user correctly.
WorkerReport.to_dict | low | Uses round on elapsed_seconds but other numeric fields are not rounded; inconsistency. | Decide if rounding should be consistent.

handoff.purpose: Define helper functions for read-only DB access, spec resolution, WorkerReport dataclass, and ProjectionWorker __init__.

symbols.name: _ro_connect
symbols.note: Returns a read-only SQLite connection or None if path is ':memory:' or does not exist.

symbols.name: _stored_specs
symbols.note: Reads embedding_indexes table and returns list of EmbeddingSpec; returns empty list on error.

symbols.name: _stored_source_hashes
symbols.note: Returns set of source_hash strings for a given index_id; returns empty set on error.

symbols.name: _stored_watermark
symbols.note: Returns JournalPosition for given index_id and journal_id, or None if not found or error.

symbols.name: resolve_spec
symbols.note: Resolves an EmbeddingSpec from stored specs and parameters; may raise SpecConflictError.

symbols.name: WorkerReport
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass holding worker execution report; includes to_dict method.

symbols.name: WorkerReport.behind_bytes
symbols.note: Calculates difference between live_position and watermark_position.

symbols.name: WorkerReport.to_dict
symbols.note: Returns dictionary representation of the report.

symbols.name: _Progress
symbols.note: Internal dataclass to track projection progress counters.

symbols.name: ProjectionWorker
symbols.note: Moves derived vector index forward to match authoritative journal; __init__ defined.

claims.text: because there is no public 'has this event already been projected?' API, and because ``--dry-run`` must be able to answer that question without creating the database.
claims.why: The comment refers to an external API and a --dry-run flag; neither is present in this chunk.

claims.text: ``dimension=None`` means 'adopt whatever this database already uses for this identity', which is what keeps a repeat run free of backend calls.
claims.why: When dimension is None and siblings exist, the function returns a sibling spec (line 388-392) or raises an error if multiple dimensions exist; it does not make backend calls.

claims.text: An explicitly declared dimension that disagrees with a stored index is a refusal, not a second index: silently forking the coordinate system is the failure this whole module exists to avoid.
claims.why: If dimension is not None and conflicting siblings exist, the function raises SpecConflictError (lines 397-405), refusing to proceed.

observations.what: The comment about 'no public API' and '--dry-run' is uncheckable.
resolve_spec docstring claims that dimension=None avoids backend calls; the function does not make any external calls.
resolve_spec docstring claims that dimension conflict causes refusal; the function raises SpecConflictError.
WorkerReport.to_dict rounds elapsed_seconds but not other numeric fields.
